The SOS group uses multiple autonomous marine platforms to gather physical, chemical, and biological ocean data. This data is essential for long-term ecosystem monitoring and supporting fisheries management in regions like the California Current and the Antarctic Peninsula.

title: PSD Data Resources
text:
Google Cloud Buckets
pifsc-1; Acoustics (PAM-SI): Holds raw passive acoustic monitoring data (e.g. wav, xwav, sud, etc.)
pifsc-1-detector-output; Acoustics (PAM-SI): Contains processing outputs from various data streams (e.g. PAMGuard database and binary files)
pifsc-1-working; Acoustics (PAM-SI): Contains all other data some of which can be temporary depending on the need.
nmfs-pifsc-cetacean-visual-survey-raw; Cetaceans: Visual survey data
nmfs-pifsc-cetacean-visual-survey-processed; Cetaceans: Contains processing outputs from various data streams
nmfs-dev-uc1-pifsc-psd; Photos (cetaceans/monk seals/turtles): Optics-SI bucket access
nmfs-pifsc-ums; UMS: Seaglider outputs other than the acoustic raw recordings
